response.overview: We all live in a shared society, yet somewhere along the way, we have grown accustomed to distrusting others before understanding them. To avoid being taken advantage of, we attack first. To protect ourselves from getting hurt, we keep our distance. Distrust has quietly become a part of everyday life.  Public Restroom is a black comedy that explores this reality through one of the most private and uncomfortable spaces imaginable—a public restroom. Two strangers, trapped in an absurd situation, quickly label each other as a pervert and a scammer. However, as they are forced to cooperate, they gradually realize that neither is a villain, but simply an ordinary person trying to protect themselves.
